articles.title: האסון הרוחני יהיה על הידיים של הרבנים החרדים
articles.summary: קואליציית השמאל של איזנקוט הולכת ונרקמת, הרבנים החרדים - הרב לנדו והרב הירש לא יוכלו לרחוץ בניקיון כפיהם ולהגיד "ידינו לא שפכו את הדם הזה". עוד אפשר לעצור את האסון הרוחני שמתקרב על עם ישראל
paragraphs: הרבנים החרדים עוד יכולים למנוע את החרפה. קואליציית השמאל של איזנקוט הולכת ונרקמת, והקו המסתמן בה הוא ממשלה חילונית אנטי דתית.
למנות את יאיר גולן כשר לביטחון פנים, את נעמה לזימי כשרת הרווחה ואת חברי המפלגה לראשות ועדות החוקה ולוועדה לבחירת שופטים יש משמעות אחת עבור הציבור המאמין: הולך להיות פה רע.
אם ממשלת 61 של בנט מינתה את גלי בהרב מיארה והיא זו שהחליטה על הפסקת התקציבים לישיבות ובעיקר על רדיפת העריקים החרדים - צאו וחשבו מה תעשה ממשלה כזו שהחרדים הם רק קישוט בה - תומכים מבחוץ.

לא צריך להיות גאון כדי להבין, שכל ההבטחות שמקבלים עכשיו הרבנים והעסקנים, על חוק הגיוס ושמירת הסטטוס-קוו בנושאי דת ומדינה, לא שוות כלום. רק לפני חודש אותם אנשים הבטיחו שיעשו הכל בשביל להפסיק את ההשתמטות החרדית, אז איך אפשר להאמין למילה שלהם? ערבויות? מילה של ליברמן זו מילה. כידוע. המחשבה לפיה בג"צ יאשר את חוק הגיוס, בגלל שמדובר בממשלת שמאל, היא אופטימיות על סף הנאיביות. ממשלת בנט-לפיד השברירית נפלה בגלל שהשמאל לא התאפק וחייב את בתי החולים להכניס חמץ בפסח. אי אפשר לטעות ולחשוב שהפעם זה יהיה אחרת.
הרבנים הליטאים - הרב לנדו והרב הירש לא יוכלו לרחוץ את ידיהם ולהגיד "ידינו לא שפכו את הדם הזה". כל חילולי השבת, הנישואים האזרחיים, בעיות הכשרות וחילון המדינה יהיו בהכרח באשמתם.
עוד אפשר למנוע את החרפה הזו.

articles.title: Eisenkot and Golan reach coalition agreement in bid to replace Netanyahu
articles.summary: The Democrats are set to receive four ministries and a seat on the Judicial Selection Committee; Liberman warns Eisenkot against a rotation deal with Netanyahu, while Bennett pushes for national unity and negotiations with ultra-Orthodox parties continue
paragraphs: The Democrats are set to receive four ministries and a seat on the Judicial Selection Committee; Liberman warns Eisenkot against a rotation deal with Netanyahu, while Bennett pushes for national unity and negotiations with ultra-Orthodox parties continue

Yashar party chairman Gadi Eisenkot and Democrats chairman Yair Golan announced Thursday that they had reached an agreement on the terms of a coalition deal, marking the second such agreement within the political bloc seeking to replace Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government, following an agreement with Avigdor Liberman's Yisrael Beitenu party.

The announcement came after Liberman warned Eisenkot against falling for what he described as a political maneuver by Netanyahu, while former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett, chairman of the Together party, renewed his call for a Zionist national unity government initially headed by Eisenkot.
Gadi Eisenkot and Yair Golan reach coalition agreement
(Photo: Shutterstock, Yariv Katz))

According to the Democrats, the agreement, contingent on the formation of a government replacing Netanyahu's coalition, includes a commitment to fully reversing the judicial overhaul, preserving judicial independence and securing significant gains for Israeli society, democracy and the country's Arab community.

Under the agreement, the Democrats would receive four ministerial portfolios: an expanded Internal Security Ministry, Labor and Welfare, Communications, and Culture and Sports, which would include a newly established democracy administration.

The Social Equality Ministry would also fall under the responsibility of Democrats ministers. The party would chair the Knesset's Constitution, Law and Justice Committee and receive additional parliamentary positions. A party representative would serve on the Judicial Selection Committee, while another would serve as the minister responsible for coordinating relations between the government and the Knesset.

Explaining its decision to relinquish its demand for the Justice Ministry, the Democrats said their commitment to forming a new government and their sense of national responsibility required them to act quickly, reach agreements and demonstrate a willingness to compromise.
The parties are continuing to finalize the remaining details ahead of signing the coalition agreement.

"We promised the public that we would replace Netanyahu and defend democracy. And that is what we will do," Golan said. "I call on all parties to reach and sign agreements as soon as possible, form a government and lead Israel in a new direction. This is our life's mission."

In a statement released shortly before the announcement, Bennett argued that a national unity government could advance the military conscription of ultra-Orthodox men and prioritize Israelis who serve in the armed forces.
He said the alternative would entail significant concessions on ultra-Orthodox conscription and policies benefiting those who serve, while relying on non-Zionist Arab political parties.
Bennett's party said he had met with Eisenkot, Netanyahu and their representatives in recent weeks and would continue to do so as necessary, with Eisenkot's full knowledge.
(Photo: Shutterstock, Shalev Shalom, Ryan Preuss)

"Under no circumstances will the Together party join Netanyahu's bloc," the party said, adding that it would not allow Netanyahu to use negotiations to run down the 24 days remaining in Eisenkot's mandate to form a government.
Liberman, meanwhile, warned that Netanyahu could offer Eisenkot a rotation agreement under which Netanyahu would serve as prime minister second.

"The government of change is taking shape. Netanyahu will try to thwart its formation at any cost," Liberman wrote. "I do not rule out the possibility that he will offer Gadi Eisenkot a rotation agreement in which Netanyahu goes second, but everyone must understand that this is merely a trick."

Liberman argued that Netanyahu wanted another election, particularly following Wednesday's developments in his criminal trial. He claimed the prime minister would prolong unity government negotiations until the last possible moment before seeking a pretext to abandon them.
Even if such a government were formed, Liberman said, Netanyahu would seek to manufacture a crisis within months to send Israel back to the polls.

Negotiations between Eisenkot's Yashar party and Netanyahu's Likud on a possible unity government took place Wednesday but were particularly brief. The parties adjourned to attend a Knesset plenary session and did not resume their discussions.

Following Liberman's assertion that a government with a clear Jewish majority could be presented by next week, Ra'am chairman Mansour Abbas said Thursday that the path toward forming a government was becoming clearer.

In an interview with Arabic-language Makan radio, Abbas predicted that the next government would comprise the parties seeking to replace Netanyahu, the ultra-Orthodox United Torah Judaism party and his Islamist Ra'am party, with parliamentary backing from the Joint List.
Will they support the next government? Mansour Abbas and Yaakov Asher

Eisenkot hopes to finalize and sign a coalition agreement with Bennett by Saturday night, completing agreements with all parties within the bloc seeking to replace Netanyahu. Together, these parties account for 48 seats in the 120-member Knesset.

Alongside these efforts, Eisenkot is pursuing negotiations with United Torah Judaism, whose support would require a complex package of legislative and legal measures addressing the military conscription of ultra-Orthodox men.

Rabbi Moshe Hillel Hirsch, one of the leading spiritual authorities of the non-Hasidic ultra-Orthodox community, returned to Israel Thursday following a fundraising trip to the United States. Ultra-Orthodox political factions had been awaiting his return before making decisions.

The emerging negotiations require agreement on a military conscription framework, a government-sponsored bill subject to legal review and temporary legislation addressing the arrest of ultra-Orthodox draft evaders.

The package is intended to offer practical solutions to the ultra-Orthodox parties' demands rather than general promises of a future arrangement. Negotiations on these issues are being conducted separately from Eisenkot's coalition agreements with other parties.
United Torah Judaism, however, denied reports of progress in negotiations with representatives of the bloc seeking to replace Netanyahu.
"Contrary to reports, United Torah Judaism is not currently discussing the allocation of ministries or positions," the party said.

It said its priorities remained regulating the legal status of yeshiva students and Torah scholars, preserving the independence of ultra-Orthodox education, maintaining existing arrangements on religion and state, and safeguarding Israel's Jewish character.

Meanwhile, United Torah Judaism lawmaker Meir Porush, considered a right-wing figure within the party, has maintained closer contact with Netanyahu than with representatives of the rival political bloc.

articles.title: בן גביר באזהרה לחרדים: "אל תצטרפו לדבר הזה"
articles.summary: השר לביטחון לאומי איתמר בן גביר פנה למפלגות החרדיות בעקבות ההכרזה על יאיר גולן כמחליפו הצפוי בתפקיד: "אל תצטרפו לדבר הזה, אל תתנו יד לממשלת שמאל על סטרואידים"
paragraphs: השר לביטחון לאומי איתמר בן גביר פנה היום (חמישי) במסר למפלגות החרדיות, זאת על רקע חתימת ההסכם הקואליציוני בין "ישר!" לדמוקרטים לפיו יאיר גולן יחליף את בן גביר בתפקיד. בדבריו קרא לחרדים שלא להצטרף לממשלת השמאל בראשות איזנקוט. "המחבלים שמחים, היהודים בוכים. זו ידיעה רעה מאוד" אמר בן גביר. "איזנקוט מתכוון למנות את יאיר גולן לשר לביטחון לאומי". בן גביר הוסיף והזכיר כי "יאיר גולן כבר הבטיח לסגור את המשמר הלאומי, לבטל את כיתות הכוננות, לקחת נשקים מהציבור במדינת ישראל ולהחזיר את הקייטנות בבתי הכלא. הממשלה המסתמנת היא ממשלה רעה מאוד, ואנחנו ניאבק בה".
בסיכום דבריו השר יצא במסר: "אני קורא לחרדים - אל תצטרפו לדבר הזה, אל תתנו יד לממשלת שמאל על מלא, ממשלת שמאל על סטרואידים".

articles.title: Gérard Depardieu to stand trial for alleged rape of actress in 2018, court rules
articles.summary: A Paris appeals court rules Depardieu will go on trial for the alleged rape of Charlotte Arnould.
paragraphs: French film actor Gérard Depardieu is to stand trial for the alleged rape of actress Charlotte Arnould, a Paris appeals court has confirmed.
Arnould, who was 22 at the time, had reported the alleged rape several days after going to his house in Paris to rehearse a play.
She has waived her right to anonymity and her lawyer said Thursday's ruling was a "first" and the forthcoming trial would be historic.

Depardieu, 77, had contested his indictment on two counts of rape. In a letter published in Le Figaro in 2023, Depardieu strongly denied Arnould's allegations, saying "there was never any coercion or violence between us".

Depardieu was for decades a leading figure in French and international cinema for roles in Green Card, The Man in the Iron Mask and the Asterix films. He was awarded France's Légion d'honneur in 1996.

But in recent years a series of allegations have been made against him over his conduct on film sets and elsewhere in the wake of France's #MeToo movement, known as balance ton porc (call out your pig).

Last year, he was given an 18-month suspended jail term after he was found guilty of sexually assaulting two women on a film set in Paris in May. He was also placed on the sex offenders register and ordered to pay compensation.
He dropped his appeal against the ruling last week and offered "sincere apologies" for his behaviour on the set of director Jean Becker's 2021 film Les Volets Verts (The Green Shutters).
Depardieu had been a friend of Charlotte Arnould's father and on 7 August 2018 she had gone to his home, where much of what happened was captured on the actor's own CCTV.
Arnould's case was initially dismissed for insufficient evidence, but after she filed a civil complaint, a judicial investigation was opened in the summer of 2020.
Speaking outside the Paris appeal court on Thursday, her lawyer Carine Durrieu Diebolt said the ruling was a victory for her client for whom it was "genuinely a relief".
The appeal court said that while Depardieu should stand trial for what took place on that day, he would not be tried for a further alleged rape at a hotel six days later.

Depardieu's lawyer David-Olivier Kaminski told reporters that court had partly ruled in his favour: "As soon as we get the ruling, we will look into the possibility of appealing to the Court of Cassation."
Meanwhile, Depardieu is under a separate investigation alongside French author Michel Houellebecq for "allegations of a sexual nature".
French authorities confirmed their inquiry last week, following reports of an alleged "gang rape" on the set of the film Thalasso in 2018.
If you have been affected by any of the issues raised in this story, details of help and support in the UK are available at BBC Action Line.

articles.title: Pregnant US inmate escapes in prison vehicle after medical appointment
articles.summary: Rebecca Taylor had been imprisoned in New Mexico for multiple theft and burglary charges.
paragraphs: A pregnant inmate has escaped from custody in the US state of New Mexico, after taking control of a police vehicle while returning to prison from a prenatal appointment, the state's corrections department has said.
Rebecca Taylor, 26, took control of the Dodge Journey and drove away when the team transporting her and another inmate stopped to pick up food in Albuquerque, local media reported.
The New Mexico Corrections Department said that the vehicle and her prison jumpsuit were later recovered, but Taylor remains on the run.
She had been imprisoned for multiple theft and burglary charges, the department said in a Facebook statement.
Local media reported that another inmate, also travelling back from a prenatal appointment, was able to get out of the car as Taylor took control on Wednesday morning.
The corrections department has said that a multi-agency search for Taylor is under way. The BBC has approached it for an update.

The Albuquerque Journal reported that Taylor is currently in her second trimester of pregnancy. For this reason, she was not restrained during transportation, department spokesperson Brittany Roembach said.
"It is the understanding right now that one officer was with the vehicle but not inside of the vehicle when this occurred," she was quoted as saying.
All prisons in New Mexico went into lockdown following Taylor's escape, but it was lifted at 06:00 on Thursday.
However the prison where she was being held, the Western New Mexico Corrections Facility, will remain on "modified movement", and no visitors are currently allowed.
The public has been told not to approach Rebecca Taylor if they see her, and call police straight away.

articles.title: Norse Atlantic suspends all flights as it faces potential collapse
articles.summary: The carrier is looking for urgent funding, but will file for bankruptcy without a financial lifeline.
paragraphs: One aircraft was meant to depart London for Orlando this morning, while another was meant to arrive from Cape Town this evening.
The suspension has also affected Pakistan International Airlines, which had been leasing aircraft and crews from Norse Atlantic.
PIA was forced to cancel services from London to Islamabad and from Manchester to Lahore last night.
In a statement on social media, PIA said all UK flights from today would be operated by aircraft from its own fleet.
Londoner Fred was due to fly to Cape Town with Norse Atlantic next week for a friend's wedding, but has decided to change his plans.
"Yesterday the exact same flight I was going to get was cancelled, so I was worried" he told the BBC's Your Voice. "I sent an email to Norse and have had nothing back".
He decided to rebook with a different airline, which cost him an extra £1,000.
Another traveller, Claire from Herefordshire, is currently on holiday in South Africa with her daughter.
"We are due to fly home on Sunday and are now looking at a really expensive flight back," she said.
"We have tried contacting Norse but have been given an automated response saying someone will get back to us within three business days."
Norse Atlantic Airways was set up in 2021 as a low-cost long-haul carrier.
It entered the market as a successor to Norwegian, which withdrew from long haul routes as a result of the Covid pandemic.
But it has struggled to make money, and its problems worsened this year, as fuel prices rocketed due to the war in Iran.
Unlike many other European carriers, Norse Atlantic does not hedge its fuel bills by buying supplies in advance at fixed prices.
This left it fully exposed when prices soared, with the cost of fuel roughly doubling at one point. Prices remain significantly higher than they were before the conflict began.
In the first half of the year Norse Atlantic made a loss of $94.6m.
In a statement to the Oslo Stock Exchange on Wednesday, the airline said its financial situation was critical, and it needed to find short term funding to continue its operations.
After suspending flights, the company said it was in discussions with investors regarding a possible takeover that "would include a financing solution".
However, it said if short term funding could not be found quickly, "it is the Board's intention to file for bankruptcy".
Norse Atlantic had been looking for a buyer since July.

Its potential collapse follows the failure of Spirit Airlines in May. The US-based low cost carrier was another airline left exposed when jet fuel prices soared, as US airlines typically do not hedge their purchases.

If Norse Atlantic were to fold, it would be another major setback for the low-cost long-haul model, which has typically proved popular with passengers but difficult to sustain financially, especially on transatlantic routes.
Additional reporting by Rozina Sini

articles.title: ההישג של קשת 12: הסדרה ששוברת שיאי צפייה
articles.summary: "הבריחה" מסכמת עונת שיא בקשת 12: רגע לפני שפרק הסיום ישודר הערב, התכנסו כוכבי הסדרה להקרנה סגורה
paragraphs: רגע לפני שפרק הסיום הדרמטי של "הבריחה" יעלה הערב למסך בקשת 12, כוכבי סדרת הדרמה הנצפית ביותר של השנה נפגשו אמש לחגיגה נוצצת במיוחד.

השחקנים והיוצרים התכנסו בביתו של יקי רייסנר להקרנה חגיגית וסגורה של פרק הפינאלה. בין האורחים שהגיעו למקום נרשמה נוכחות מרשימה של הסטארים הגדולים: יהודה לוי, עידו טאקו, נאיה בינשטוק, מאור שוויצר, איתי תורג'מן, ליה אללוף, נועם לוגסי, פיליפ שאולוב, ורואי שחר קרמרמן (נחמן). "הבריחה" מסכמת עונה חלומית שבה שברה שיאים והפכה לאחת מהדרמות המובילות בטלוויזיה, עם ממוצע רייטינג מרשים של 18% ולמעלה מ-650 אלף צופים לכל פרק בהשלמות הצפייה לאורך השבוע. הערב, כאמור, הדרמה מגיעה לשיאה בפרק סיום מותח במיוחד.

articles.title: Beau Lamarre-Condon used his service weapon to murder two men. Did NSW police recruiters miss any red flags?
articles.summary: Video of convicted double murderer shows him in 2020 deploying a Taser at close range to an Indigenous man’s face, chest and neck Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Beau Lamarre-Condon, the double murderer who killed Jesse Baird and Luke Davies while he was a serving New South Wales police officer, had been under review by the force for repeatedly using his Taser on a man four years before the killings. On Wednesday, he was convicted after a 12-person jury found he had murdered both men with his police service weapon on 19 February 2024. Continue reading...
paragraphs: Beau Lamarre-Condon, the double murderer who killed Jesse Baird and Luke Davies while he was a serving New South Wales police officer, had been under review by the force for repeatedly using his Taser on a man four years before the killings.
On Wednesday, he was convicted after a 12-person jury found he had murdered both men with his police service weapon on 19 February 2024.

During his 10-week trial, the prosecution alleged Lamarre-Condon had misused his authority as a police officer to obtain CCTV footage of Baird, who he had casually dated; stolen training bullets from the police; and taken a weapon from a police station to use in his crimes.
The NSW police commissioner, Mal Lanyon, has offered his thoughts to the families of Baird and Davies and condemned Lamarre-Condon.

“The actions for which Mr Lamarre-Condon has now been convicted are abhorrent and completely at odds with his oath of office as a police officer which he undertook. His actions are unacceptable to me, the NSW Police Force and to any member of our community,” he said in a statement.
“I also wish to acknowledge the professionalism and dedication of those officers who conducted the investigation into the deaths of Mr Baird and Mr Davies.”
But the trial’s revelations have raised questions about how NSW police recruits its officers.

“If police recruitment processes and then police professional standards can let this guy get through all the gates, we need to review our checks and balances,” Dr Justin Ellis, a University of Newcastle criminology lecturer, told Guardian Australia.
“Authority figures are expected to meet higher ethical and behavioural standards, and in this case, the additional responsibility that comes with being a police officer.”
The circumstances surrounding Lamarre-Condon’s recruitment and ongoing employment are being examined by a coronial inquest and a critical incident investigation, NSW police said in a statement.
Terry Goldsworthy, a criminologist at Bond University and former detective, suggested the force revisit Lamarre-Condon’s assessment to see whether any red flags were missed.
He added that Lamarre-Condon’s case is an “extraordinary exception” rather than indicative of systemic issues in the police.

But Ellis believes this type of framing, which narrows focus to individual actors, must be taken into wider consideration of the police processes that “may have enabled the ‘bad apple’ to be in place and to stay in place”.
Separate from the police response to the murders, recruitment processes have been investigated as part of a broader independent cultural review, released in June.
It recommended the NSW police force change testing and vetting processes that unintentionally exclude capable candidates, following recent downturns in applicants.

Applicants to the police academy are required to undertake a psychometric test, but former police officer turned criminologist at Macquarie University, Vincent Hurley, said “anyone can bluff a questionnaire”.
He said police should, and may already have, reviewed Lamarre-Condon’s psychometric testing, as well as any complaints by the public or other officers about his behaviour.
Years of staff shortages are placing pressure on recruiting and retaining officers, which can lead to complaints being overlooked, Hurley said.

Four years before the murders and about three years into his policing career, Lamarre-Condon became the subject of an internal police review after video emerged of him repeatedly deploying a Taser on an Indigenous man in the face, chest and neck.
During the June 2020 incident, Lamarre-Condon yells, “If you move, I will Taser you,” before pulling the man to the ground and firing his stun gun.
The man says: “Are you serious? I’m trying to protect my face, I’m not even fighting you.”
An internal review by NSW police cleared Lamarre-Condon of any wrongdoing, finding that he had complied with policy and training guidelines, The Australian reported.
Police faced intense scrutiny after the murders first occurred in 2024.

Then police commissioner Karen Webb came under fire when she described the killings as a “crime of passion” and responded to criticism by saying: “There will always be haters. Haters like to hate. Isn’t that what Taylor [Swift] says?”
During the trial, it was revealed Baird did not believe he could report Lamarre-Condon’s stalking and controlling behaviour to law enforcement because of his role in the police.

Even if he did report the officer, Hurley said there was a chance police may not have taken him seriously because he did not fit the mould of a “stereotypical” victim of such behaviour – referring to the fact he was not in a heterosexual relationship.
Hurley said Baird and Davies’ deaths were a “wake-up call” for police in how such matters are handled.

The independent NSW MP Alex Greenwich, who helped facilitate a 2024 vigil for Baird and Davies, said after the verdicts: “This tragic and heartbreaking violent crime tells us we need to do everything we can do to increase awareness, reporting, support and access to justice for LGBTQ victims of stalking and violence.”

People in the LGBTQ+ community have long faced discrimination when engaging with police and the justice system, with a 2022 special commission of inquiry into LGBTQ+ hate crimes revealing police reluctance to thoroughly investigate homicides and assaults involving gay men and transgender women.
Ellis, who is part of a NSW police force taskforce established in response to inquiry, said police have an opportunity to renew their engagement strategies with the LGBTQ+ community.
“The more that they’re trusted and people have confidence in them, the more likely [people] are to report to the police.”
In the wake of the murders, NSW police reviewed and implemented changes to the force’s firearms policies and procedures, which have been welcomed by Hurley and Goldsworthy.
At the time of Lamarre-Condon’s arrest, the NSW police force launched its critical incident investigation, which is ongoing and being monitored by the Law Enforcement Conduct Commission.
The investigation will also be reviewed by the police’s professional standards command.
Eventual findings from the ongoing coronial inquest may offer recommendations for the police.

articles.title: "שוחד מובהק" או "לא יהיה כלום": הפרשנויות שקרסו כמו התיקים
articles.summary: מההבטחות להרשעה עד ערעור על ההליך המשפטי כולו משפט נתניהו הגיע לפרשת דרכים וכל הדיבורים המוחלטים לגביו מהעבר מוטלים בספק
paragraphs: הדרמה המשפטית המתנהלת בעשור האחרון סביב ראש הממשלה בנימין נתניהו הגיעה לשיא חדש באולם בית המשפט המחוזי בירושלים הגיעה לשיא חדש בדיון מיוחד בנוכחות היועצת המשפטית לממשלה, גלי בהרב מיארה. בסוף הדיון דיווחו כל האתרים והערוצים, גם אלה שאינם ממעריציו הגדולים של נתניהו, כי השופטים הציעו לשקול לוותר על כתב אישום בתיק 4000 כולו (כולל שוחד והפרת אמונים), ציינו כי קיים ספק רציני אם המעשים המיוחסים לראש הממשלה נתניהו בתיק 2000 מהווים עבירה, והמליצו לסיים בהסדר את הדיונים בתיק 1000.

המהלך השיפוטי הזה מחייב סקירה מחדש של פרשנויות תקשורתיות נחרצות ומתנגשות בהקשר למשפט המדובר בישראל בעשור האחרון. בצד אחד נשמעו לאורך השנים קולות שראו בתיקים תשתית ראייתית מכרעת, ובצד השני נשמעו קולות שהכריזו שוב ושוב כי מדובר בתיקים רעועים שיקרסו כולם או יסתיימו בקול ענות חלושה בפשרה או זיכוי חלקי או מלא. הקולות הבטוחים בהרשעה

לאורך שנות החקירה והמשפט הציגו פרשנים ועיתונאים רבים תמונה שלפיה חומר הראיות, ההקלטות והעדויות מציבים בפני ראש הממשלה רף פלילי כבד שיהיה קשה להפריך. בן כספית, מהמבקרים החריפים והעקביים של נתניהו, טען לאורך השנים בטוריו ובשידורים כי מדובר בהתנהלות פלילית מובהקת ובפרשת שוחד חמורה, ובראיון לרדיו 103FM בשנת 2018 אמר כספית לעיתונאי ניסים משעל:

"הרכבת הפלילית כבר יצאה מהתחנה ואני כמעט בטוח שיהיה כאן כתב אישום על שוחד". כספית הוסיף באותו ראיון מהעבר בזהירות אך בנחרצות: " בתי הקברות מלאים באנשים שהספידו את נתניהו. למרות זאת, להערכתי מדובר בישורת האחרונה שלו. אינני יודע אם זה יקרה עוד חודשיים או עוד שנה וחצי אך סוף העידן הזה מתקרב", כך אמר בן כספית לפני שמונה שנים, ולהזכירכם נכון להיום נתניהו עדיין ראש ממשלה וכספית עדיין ממשיך לטעון שהוא קרוב לסוף דרכו הפוליטית.

גם הפרשן הפוליטי של חדשות 12, אמנון אברמוביץ', חזר והדגיש באולפני החדשות את חומרת הראיות שנאספו נגד נתניהו, ובאחת מהתייחסויותיו למשפט אף קבע: "תיק 4000 הוא ה-תיק מכל התיקים". הכתב המשפטי של חדשות 12, גיא פלג, הצהיר באחד מדיווחיו על משפט נתניהו:
כתב המשפט של חדשות 13, אביעד גליקמן, לא חסך הצהרות בטוחות על תיק 4000 וכתב באתר ערוץ 13 בשנת 2019: ""זה לא תיק של ספק, זה תיק של הרשעה בטוחה" ".
רביב דרוקר הדגיש גם הוא לאורך העשור את המשמעות הפלילית של הממצאים ואת חולשת קו ההגנה, ומתח ביקורת על סחבת ההליך המשפטי כשהוא מפנה אצבע מאשימה לרה"מ נתניהו ולא למערכת המשפטית עצמה.

אייל ברקוביץ' ביטא בתוכניות בהגשתו את מה שעשוי לקרות בסוף המשפט, וכך אמר ברקוביץ' על ראש הממשלה באחת התכניות בהגשתו: "לא רוצה שתהיה בכלא, לא רוצים לראות אותך במדים כתומים. תגמור את הקדנציה, צא לגמלאות". יצוין שבעקבות הפרסומים הרבים מסוף הדיון בבית המשפט המחוזי בירושלים שינה ברקוביץ' את גישתו המוצהרת עד כה כלפי ההליך המשפטי והאשים את בכירי הפרקליטות והיועצת המשפטית לממשלה בפילוג העם. היו גם כאלה שהטילו ספקות בתיקים

בצד הימני של המפה התקשורתית, עיתונאים ופרשנים המזוהים עם המחנה התומך בנתניהו טענו בעקביות מאז פתיחת החקירות כי מדובר בתיקים שנבנו על יסודות רעועים שיקרסו במבחן המשפטי. ינון מגל חזר והכריז לאורך השנים בתוכנית הפטריוטים וברשת X כי "התיקים קורסים" וסיקור אוהד אינו מהווה עבירת שוחד, ובאחת מהתייחסויות בשנת 2022 הצהיר מגל בשידור חי : "בתקשורת השמאל טענו כי תיקי נתניהו הם ‘בטון יצוק’, שקרנים עלובים! עשיתם הפיכה שלטונית, עכשיו תאכלו את הבומרנג in your face!".

ח"כ יעקב ברדוגו שליווה את משפט נתניהו מראשיתו בעיקר מהזווית המשפטית טען לאורך כל שנות ההליך כי כתבי האישום נולדו מתוך הטיה מערכתית וכי אין בהם בסיס משפטי אמיתי, ואמר בשידור בערוץ 14: "מדובר בטירוף מערכות מוחלט! אלה עבירות פליליות שנעשו במהלך התיק. במדינה מתוקנת היו עוצרים את אותם אנשים - זה נעשה בזדון כדי לתפור תיקים לראש ממשלה מכהן ולפגוע בימין!".

גם הפרשן הפוליטי של חדשות 12 עמית סגל הצביע לאורך המשפט על קשיים ראייתיים מהותיים שעלו בדיונים, ובציטוט שלו שפורסם לאחרונה באינסטגרם התייחס סגל לסחבת המשפטית והביא דוגמא בהקשר אישי להתארכות האבסורדית של המשפט: "היום שבו החלה החקירה נגד נתניהו היה אחד הימים הגדולים בחיי: בני נולד. עכשיו הוא פחות משנתיים מהבר מצווה שלו, ונראה שהוא יהפוך לגבר יהודי לפני שנתניהו יהפוך לגבר חופשי". כנראה שרק עמית סגל יכול לעשות קשרים כאלה. נתניהו: "10 שנים של סבל"

בעקבות דברי השופטים ליועצת המשפטית לממשלה בהרב מיארה בתום הדיון בבית המשפט המחוזי בירושלים פרסם ראש הממשלה בנימין נתניהו הצהרה מיוחדת מהכנסת: "אזרחי ישראל, אחיי ואחיותיי, היום נפל דבר, היום נפל המשפט. אמרתי לפני עשר שנים 'לא יהיה כלום כי לא היה כלום', לקח עשר שנים עד שהאמת הזו יצאה לאור, עשר שנים של סבל נורא, לי לרעייתי לבניי, של חקירות הזויות, של רצח אופי, של הסתה קשה שפוצעת את הנפש. מי יחזיר לנו את עשר השנים האלה?".

בהמשך דבריו קרא נתניהו לסיים את ההליך לאלתר ולפנות לאיחוד מחודש של העם שנקרע לדבריו בעקבות "התיקים המהונדסים" כהגדרתו, והוסיף: "דווקא ביום הזה אני מושיט יד לפיוס. אני יודע מול איזה סכנות עצומות עומדת המדינה, ואנחנו חייבים להתאחד כדי להבטיח את עתיד ישראל. ידי מושטת לאחדות".

משפט רה"מ נתניהו נמשך ופסק הדין המלא עוד רחוק, אך סיכום ביניים לאור ההתפתחויות האחרונות והצבת הערות השופטים מול עשור של כותרות ופרשנויות מחדדת את הפער בין פרשנות אולפנים להכרעה שיפוטית, מוכיח כי מי שסימן תוצאה מראש לכל כיוון, נאלץ כעת להתמודד עם מציאות משפטית מורכבת מכפי שהייתה לפני כעשור בתחילת משפט רה"מ כשסופו עדיין לא נראה באופק.

articles.title: Two Italian defense technicians killed in Iranian drone attack on Kuwait
articles.summary: The victims worked for German defense giant Rheinmetall and reportedly operated anti-drone systems; Kuwait says the attack targeted a ‘vital site,’ leaving two others wounded and forcing civilian aircraft to change routes
paragraphs: The victims worked for German defense giant Rheinmetall and reportedly operated anti-drone systems; Kuwait says the attack targeted a ‘vital site,’ leaving two others wounded and forcing civilian aircraft to change routes

Two Italian nationals were killed Thursday in an Iranian drone attack on Kuwait, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters, confirming an earlier report by Italian news agency ANSA. The victims were technicians working for German defense giant Rheinmetall.
Kuwait's Defense Ministry initially reported that four people, including the two Italian nationals, had been wounded in the attack.
A strike in Kuwait, file photo
(Photo: Various sources / AFP)
In an official statement, the ministry said Kuwaiti security forces had detected several hostile drones in the country's airspace and had taken "appropriate measures" in response.
"This unlawful Iranian aggression targeted a vital site and caused falling debris that injured four people: a Kuwaiti national, two Italian nationals and a Pakistani national," the ministry said.
The wounded were taken to a hospital for treatment, and the attack also caused property damage. ANSA subsequently reported that the two Italians had died of their injuries.

Kuwait's Defense Ministry did not identify the targeted site or disclose the extent of the damage. It stressed that the country's armed forces remained on high alert and were taking all necessary measures to protect Kuwait's sovereignty, security and stability.

Italian newspaper La Repubblica reported that the victims had been operating anti-drone defense systems and were apparently part of a contingent of military personnel and civilians deployed since March to help defend Gulf states against Iranian attacks and protect energy sources supplying Italy.

The attack also disrupted civilian air traffic across the Gulf region. Euronews reported that aircraft traveling from Europe to Gulf countries via Iraq were forced to change course following reports that Kuwait's airspace had been closed.

Since the outbreak of the war with Iran in late February, Kuwait, which hosts U.S. military forces, has repeatedly come under Iranian attack. Kuwaiti authorities have condemned the strikes, which Tehran has carried out as part of its retaliatory campaign against Gulf states.

articles.title: 5 דיווחים דרמטיים, מסר אחד: עופר ינאי מאותת לשוק ההון שהוא יכול להסתדר בלעדיו
articles.summary: אחרי שנחתכה ביותר מ-60% מהשיא, המניה טסה בכמעט 20% ומוסיפה מעל 800 מיליון שקל לשווי • עופר ינאי מציג מעבר לרווח נקי של 84 מיליון שקל מפעילות שוטפת, לצד סדרת עסקאות מחוץ לבורסה שיזרימו יותר מחצי מיליארד שקל • וגם: איתות חריף לשוק האג"ח עם תוכנית רכישה עצמית של 200 מיליון שקל
paragraphs: נופר אנרגיה של עופר ינאי מבצעת סדרה של עסקאות מחוץ לבורסה, שמזניקות את המניה בשיעור אדיר של כמעט 20%, תוך זינוק של מעל 800 מיליון שקל בשווי השוק. אחרי שהמשקיעים "הענישו" את מניית נופר בחודשים האחרונים וחתכו את השווי שלה ביותר מ־60% מהשיא, נראה שעופר ינאי קם בבוקר יום חמישי עם משימה אחת - להוכיח לשוק שיש לו חלופות משמעותיות הן בגיוס הון והן בגיוס חוב. ברביעי בערב, ינאי פרסם סרטון באינסטגרם, בו הוא הבטיח ש"מחר נגמרת תקופת ההחשכה" ו"תוכלו לשמוע את האמת על נופר". כעת, כך נראה, הוא מממש את ההבטחה. נופר ידעה מספר טלטלות בשנים האחרונות, כולל התפטרות של שני המנכ"לים השותפים בנופר נדב טנא ושחר גרשון. בסופו של דבר, ינאי חזר למושב המנכ"ל בחברה שיזם, והוא כעת מוביל מדיניות של צמיחה אגרסיבית ועסקאות מחוץ לשוק.
● אחרי הפרידה מסוני: אלטייר מגייסת 100 מיליון דולר ממאבריק ופיטנגו ● המניה הביטחונית שבעיקר ירדה מאז ההנפקה, ממריאה היום ב־30%

בו זמנית, נופר מפרסמת דוח מוצלח במיוחד שכולל מעבר לרווח של ממש, שנובע לראשונה מהפעילות השוטפת. החברה מבצעת עסקאות באירופה, כולל השקעה של עד 100 מיליון אירו מצד לאומי פרטנרס. היא צפויה להכניס שותף נוסף לתחנת הכוח העתידית, ריינדיר, ורוכשת אג"חים שלה מהשוק כדי לצמצם את מרווחי החוב שלה לאור הזדמנויות טובות בהרבה ממשקיעים פרטיים או מהבנקים. לאור הזינוק במניית נופר, עם עליה משמעותית נוספת במניות חברות מקבילות, תל אביב קלינטק עולה בכ-6%.
הזרוע האירופית: השקעה של עד 100 מיליון אירו מלאומי והחלפת נכסים מול קרן נוי

נופר אנרגיה מבצעת שני מהלכים משמעותיים בפעילות האירופאית שלה, שכוללת נכסים ברומניה, ספרד, איטליה, בריטניה, גרמניה, פולין, סרביה וליטא. היא מבצעת החלפת נכסים מול קרן נוי באירופה, ורוכשת מידי השותפות איתה מספר נכסים משמעותיים בספרד, בתמורה ל-12.4% מחברת סאנפריים. בסך הכל, הדבר צפוי להכניס לנופר עשרות מיליוני שקלים ל- EBITDA בזמן שהיא מחזקת את אחיזתה באירופה. נכון להיום, במספר מדינות אירופאיות הרווחים מפעילות אגירת חשמל נחשבים גבוהים במיוחד, מה שמוביל את נופר להשקיע משמעותית בצירוף סוללות אגירה לפרויקטים שלה.

בנוסף לכך, נופר חתמה על מזכר הבנות בלתי מחייב עם לאומי פרטנרס במסגרתה לאומי ישקיעו בין 75 ל-100 מיליון אירו בחברת הבת שלה נופר אירופה. אחת מארבע פירמות החשבונאות הגדולות יבצעו הערכת שווי של נופר אירופה, ובהתאם לכך לאומי יחליטו כמה להשקיע - ובתמורה לכמה. תאריך הפקיעה של מזכר ההבנות הוא עד ה-23 בפברואר 2027. נופר אירופה היא חברת בת בבעלות מלאה של נופר, וכעת נראה שהיא מעוניינת להכניס את לאומי כמשקיע אסטרטגי כדי לממן את המשך ההתרחבות, שכולל נכסים מניבים באירופה ו"צנרת" פרויקטים עתידית. בכך, נופר מראה שהיא מסוגלת לגייס הון משמעותי בעזרת מימוש של הנכסים שלה באירופה, ללא תלות בבורסה.
מימוש של 350 מיליון שקל בישראל - בדרך לרכישת תחנת הכוח ריינדיר

גם בישראל, נופר בדרך למכירה של 50% מפרויקטים בישראל לחברת ואי אר מוריה, בהספק של 350 מגה-וואט וקיבולת אגירה של 115 מגה-וואט שעה. זאת תמורת 350 מיליון שקל, דבר המשקף שווי של 700 מיליון שקל לחלקה של נופר בפרויקטים המדוברים. העסקה צפויה להיחתם תוך 45 יום מהיום, כלומר עד ינואר 2027. ואי אר מוריה היא חברה פרטית, שהקים יוסי רפאלוב, איש צבא שהיה בתפקיד האחרון שלו נספח צבאי בהודו ועושה שם את עיקר העסקים שלו. על פי עופר ינאי, הקשר נוצר דרך יו"ר נגה לשעבר סמי תורג'מן, שהיה המג"ד של ינאי בגדוד 52 של חיל השריון. נופר צפויה להכניס מעסקאות אלו מעל חצי מיליארד שקל, שאותן כנראה תשקיע בהמשך ההתרחבות האגרסיבית שלה, כולל רכישה של כמחצית מתחנת הכוח הקונבנציונלית העתידית ריינדיר.

את רכישת התחנה נופר דחתה לפברואר 2027, זאת כדי להכניס שותף נוסף לתחנת הכוח. נכון להיום, השותפים הנוכחיים בה, בין השאר פאוורג'ן (של קרן התשתיות ג'נריישן קפיטל ) ורפק אנרג'י , צפויים לקבל בקרוב מרשות החשמל את תעריף הזמינות שתחנת הכוח תקבל על השעות בהן היא זמינה לרשת החשמל הארצית, בנוסף לחשמל שהיא תמכור. ברגע שריינדיר תשיג את תעריף הזמינות המדויק, היא תוכל לגשת לשותף נוסף ולעניין אותו בכניסה לתחנת הכוח, מה שיאפשר לנופר להשיג נתח משמעותי בה תוך השקעה נמוכה יותר (כנראה כ-200 מיליון שקל) של הון ראשוני. המנכ"ל והיזם, עופר ינאי, אמר בשיחה למשקיעים שריינדיר תדרוש "צ'ק עצום, צ'ק של מיליארד שקל, 47%. יכול להיות שצריך להביא משהו נוסף". זאת במיוחד אם רשות החשמל לא תאפשר לפאוורג'ן לשמור על החזקותיהם בריינדיר לאחר הרכישה של שיכון ובינוי אנרגיה, שתגדיל דרמטית את היקף השליטה של פאוורג'ן בשוק ייצור החשמל מגז.
איתות חריף לשוק החוב: רכישה עצמית של אג"ח ב-200 מיליון שקל

בנוסף לכל אלו, נופר מבצעת רכישה עצמית של אגרות חוב שהנפיקה בעבר, בסכום של עד 200 מיליון שקל. זאת מכיוון שלנופר אנרגיה יש הזדמנויות לחוב במרווח טוב בהרבה במקורות אחרים: "היות שזמינים לנו מקורות אשראי זולים משמעותית, אנחנו מגייסים בפרטי אשראי בהיקף של 150 עד 250 מרווח" אומר עופר ינאי. כלומר, 1.5-2.5 נקודות אחוז מעל אגרת חוב ממשלתית מקבילה. זאת לעומת מרווח של 468 שנופר משלמת בשלב זה על האג"ח שלה. מדובר לא רק על מהלך עסקי אלא גם על איתות לשוק שזמינים לנופר אפיקי גיוס חוב טובים בהרבה, ועל שוק החוב הציבורי "להתיישר" או שנופר לא תצטרך אותו. ברמז עבה, ינאי אמר בשיחת המשקיעים ש"ככל שהמחיר יתוקן, אז לא נצטרך את הדבר הזה. אבל התוכנית הזו אושרה בדירקטוריון".
מעבר לרווח של 84 מיליון שקל: "נופר עוברת משלב הייזום לשלב הקצירה"

כל המהלכים הללו מתרחשים ברקע דוח חזק במיוחד של נופר, שכולל זינוק של 172% בהכנסות מ-108 מיליון שקל ברבעון השלישי של השנה שעברה ל-294 מיליון שקל ברבעון האחרון. ה- EBITDA (רווח לפני ריבית, מיסים, פחת והפחתות) זינק ב-150% והרווח הנקי עבר מהפסד קטן של 4.6 מיליון שקל ל-84 מיליון שקל. גם תזרים המזומנים נע מהצד השלילי לתזרים חיובי של 151 מיליון שקל ברבעון הנוכחי. אמנם לא מדובר ברווח הראשון שנופר רושמת, אך כן מדובר בפעם הראשונה שהוא נובע ישירות מהפעילות השוטפת. בכך, נופר מאותתת שהיא מסוגלת להסתמך על עצמה ועל שותפות מחוץ לבורסה ולשוק החוב הרגיל כדי להתמנף, להתממן ולהתרחב אגרסיבית בהתאם למגמה בקרב חברות האנרגיה.

גם לאחר העליות הדרמטיות בבורסה, שעומדות נכון למועד כתיבת שורות אלו על מעט מתחת ל-20% ביחס לסגירת המסחר אמש, נופר עדיין שווה "רק" כ-5 מיליארד שקל, שהם כמחצית מהשווי האדיר שנתנו לה במאי 2026, מעל 10 מיליארד שקל. יש לציין שלא רק עבור נופר זה היה השיא, אלא מספר חברות גדולות בתחום האנרגיה המתחדשת הגיעו אז לשיא, ולאחר מכן השווי נסוג. כעת התנועה היא לכיוון ההפוך, וכל מדד הקלינטק בתל אביב עלה בכ-6%.

על פי יועץ ההשקעות והאנליסט ליאור וידר, בעל שירות המידע "מכפיל רווח" וכותב טור "ניתוח חברה" בגלובס, "מדובר בדוח מרשים מאוד שמוכיח כי נופר עוברת בהצלחה משלב הייזום עתיר ההון לשלב הקצירה והתזרים החזק, וכל זאת מבלי לדלל את בעלי המניות. היכולת להציג רווח נקי תפעולי נקי של 84 מלש"ח ברבעון אחד, לצד הכפלת יחס ההנבה לחוב המאוחד לכ-12.2%, משנה מהותית את פרופיל הסיכון של החברה. בנוסף, הכנסת גופים כמו לאומי פרטנרס והמימוש החלקי בסאנפריים לפי שווי גבוה מהווים הבעת אמון מוסדית ברורה ומעניקים הצדקה כלכלית לשווי הנכסים בספרים, בעוד שתוכנית הרכישה העצמית של האג"ח היא מהלך פיננסי חכם שמנצל עיוות תמחור בשוק החוב. להערכתי, כשבוחנים את התמחור הנוכחי של החברה אל מול קצב הרווח הנקי הנקי מרעשים חד-פעמיים והצמיחה הצפויה ב- EBITDA ב-2027 וב-2028, מכפיל הרווח הנקי העתידי צפוי להתכווץ בצורה משמעותית ולהפוך את המניה למעניינת מאוד בטווח הבינוני והארוך".

לתשומת לבכם: מערכת גלובס חותרת לשיח מגוון, ענייני ומכבד בהתאם ל קוד האתי המופיע בדו"ח האמון לפיו אנו פועלים. ביטויי אלימות, גזענות, הסתה או כל שיח בלתי הולם אחר מסוננים בצורה אוטומטית ולא יפורסמו באתר.

articles.title: Israeli crime boss's son extradited from US over alleged plot to assassinate rival
articles.summary: Son of underworld figure Eitan Haya returns to Israel in handcuffs after nine years abroad, accused of plotting two attempts to kill rival crime boss Eli Mosley; a US judge likened the circumstances of his transfer from Malaysia to kidnapping
paragraphs: Son of underworld figure Eitan Haya returns to Israel in handcuffs after nine years abroad, accused of plotting two attempts to kill rival crime boss Eli Mosley; a US judge likened the circumstances of his transfer from Malaysia to kidnapping

Eran Haya, son of Eitan Haya, the notorious crime boss nicknamed the "Israeli Godfather," landed in Israel Thursday morning accompanied by two detectives and an officer from the Tel Aviv Police Central Unit, completing his extradition from the United States. The detectives had arrived in New York several days earlier to arrange his unusual transfer back to Israel, nine years after he left the country.

Haya is suspected of orchestrating two attempts to assassinate Eli Mosley, the head of a rival criminal organization. Following his arrival, he was transferred to the Tel Aviv Police Central Unit for questioning over the alleged assassination plots.
Eran Haya lands in Israel, escorted by police

Extradition documents also revealed allegations that Haya himself had been targeted for assassination in Malaysia, a planned deportation to Poland that was canceled, and unusually harsh criticism from a U.S. federal judge over the circumstances of his transfer to New York, which she described as resembling a kidnapping.
The State Attorney's Office confirmed Haya's extradition, saying he was suspected of involvement in two attempts to murder Mosley approximately two years ago.

"Eran Haya is suspected of heading a criminal organization that planned and attempted, under his direction, to murder Eli Mosley and harm other members of the criminal organization headed by Mosley," prosecutors said in a statement.

"On two separate occasions, Haya and his associates attempted to murder Mosley using a powerful explosive device that was to be thrown beneath his vehicle while it was moving. The attacks were prevented at the last moment following police arrests. These actions were carried out while Haya himself was living outside Israel."

The prosecution said its International Department had submitted a request to U.S. authorities in May 2024 for Haya's provisional arrest pending extradition. He was subsequently arrested, and Israel filed a formal extradition request. After lengthy proceedings in which Haya raised numerous objections, a U.S. court ruled that he could be extradited.

"Haya's extradition once again demonstrates the cooperation between law enforcement authorities, including the Israel Police's Interpol unit, the Tel Aviv District Attorney's Office and the State Attorney's Office International Department, in locating and bringing criminals to justice from anywhere in the world," the statement said.

Police confirmed that Haya had been taken for questioning immediately upon arrival and would subsequently be brought before a court for a hearing on extending his detention. "The Israel Police will continue to act decisively, using every means at its disposal, both in Israel and abroad, to bring fugitives to justice and thwart the activities of criminal organizations," the police said in a statement.

In August 2006, Haya was arrested in Tel Aviv, just days after returning to Israel following a lengthy stay abroad, on suspicion of involvement in the murder of former police officer Tzahi Ben-Or in Mexico. Under a plea agreement, the murder charge was dropped, and Haya was convicted of aggravated assault with intent to cause serious bodily harm.
Twenty years after that arrival, Haya has returned to Israel once again, this time in handcuffs and escorted by detectives from the Tel Aviv Police Central Unit.
Eran Haya was identified as his father's successor more than a decade ago
He is suspected of orchestrating two attempts to assassinate Eli Mosley, the head of a rival criminal organization

By the time Eran was released from prison, his father was already standing trial in a case involving loans on the gray market and debt collection through threats and violence. In 2016, when the district court sentenced Eitan to 20 years in prison, Tel Aviv police intelligence had already identified Eran as his successor.

According to an intelligence assessment published later, the two men shared a circle of criminal associates who remained loyal to both father and son. Eitan was acquitted of some of his convictions on appeal, and his sentence was reduced to 12 years. He was released from Eshel Prison in March of this year.
The original 'godfather': Eitan Haya

During his father's imprisonment, Eran became close to crime boss Yossi Mosley. In 2017, Haya left Israel amid an investigation into the "Arab Spring" criminal case, which involved three murders and other offenses. According to published reports, the two men spent time in South Africa before a financial dispute emerged between them.

At the center of the current extradition request is the allegation that Haya and another suspect were behind a plot to assassinate Eli Mosley, Yossi's brother, in Tel Aviv. Investigators suspect Haya devised the plan, financed it and directed those involved. The first attempt, in January 2024, was not carried out. A second attempt was thwarted eight days later when police arrested the suspects.

The extradition request accuses Haya of two counts of attempted murder, conspiracy to commit a felony, carrying and transporting a weapon, altering the identifying details of a vehicle or vehicle component, and destruction of evidence.
The documents also allege that over approximately two years, Haya supplied members of his criminal organization with weapons and vehicles to carry out offenses against Mosley's organization.

Before his arrest, Haya lived in a heavily secured compound in Istanbul and, according to an FBI document, used Turkish identity documents under the name "Eren Kaya." In October 2023, he traveled to Malaysia, where he was arrested in April 2024. According to Haya, local police told him the arrest was intended to protect his life after someone had arrived in the country to assassinate him.

He alleged that for approximately two weeks, he was prevented from speaking with a lawyer and was brought to court hearings blindfolded and without translation. In early May, Malaysian police allegedly informed him that he would be deported to Poland and instructed him to purchase a plane ticket.

On the scheduled day of his departure, however, Haya was told the flight had been canceled. According to his account, one of the officers then informed him that American officials were expected to arrive and take custody of him.

Israel submitted its formal extradition request on June 25, 2024, and the request was filed with a U.S. court on July 19. Evidence presented by Israeli authorities included testimony from individuals involved in the alleged plots, wiretap recordings, telephone records and surveillance footage.

Haya argued that he possessed evidence establishing an alibi for some of the dates relevant to the allegations. He also claimed that a key informant had been promised a payment of $105,442 and a prison sentence capped at five years.
On June 23, 2025, U.S. Magistrate Judge Jennifer Willis ruled that Haya was eligible for extradition to Israel, while issuing unusually sharp criticism of the American authorities.

According to the judge, the U.S. government appeared to have deliberately omitted information from documents provided to an allied country, backdated documents and arranged for the removal of a U.S. citizen from a foreign country "under circumstances resembling a kidnapping."

Despite that criticism, Willis ruled that the circumstances surrounding Haya's transfer did not deprive the court of jurisdiction over his extradition proceedings. She also determined that the evidence submitted by Israel met the legal threshold required for extradition.

Attorney Nick Kaufman, who represented Haya in the extradition proceedings alongside New York attorneys Noam Biale and Justin Harris, sharply criticized the methods used to bring his client to the United States.
"Eran's case is a clear example of the questionable measures the Israel Police have adopted in recent years to return their most wanted suspects living abroad to Israel," Kaufman said.

"In this case, the Israel Police enlisted the FBI to bring Eran Haya back from a country with which Israel has no diplomatic relations and from which it therefore could not request his deportation, let alone his extradition."

articles.title: Tel Aviv Central Bus Station bridge demolition to begin January
articles.summary: The bridge demolition brings forward part of the plan to vacate the Central Bus Station, which is expected to take place in about five years.
paragraphs: The bridge demolition brings forward part of the plan to vacate the Central Bus Station, which is expected to take place in about five years.

The bridges serving Tel Aviv’s Central Bus Station are set to be demolished, as first reported by "Globes" earlier this month. The Tel Aviv-Yafo Municipality announced today that work will begin this January on the western arm, with the northern and southern arms to follow. The first phase is expected to last until April 2027 and will involve cutting and dismantling the bridge in stages, installing temporary protective systems and using heavy machinery.

The work is possible because of a window before trial runs begin on the light rail’s Purple Line, which passes close to the bridges. The municipality said postponing demolition could have left the bridges in place for many more years or required a prolonged shutdown of the Purple Line to carry out the work.

Temporary road closures and changes to public spaces are expected during the work. The northern and southern arms will be dismantled in later phases, with dates to be announced. The project is being carried out for Ahuzot HaHof and is managed by Yahel Engineers.

Mayor Ron Huldai said the move was a step toward correcting a past planning approach that, he said, had harmed local residents’ quality of life and the urban environment for years. He said dismantling the bridges was a milestone in the area’s recovery and part of a broader effort that includes switching to electric buses, dispersing bus services among terminals across the city and advancing a new planning policy for the Central Bus Station complex and its surroundings.
Egged and Dan set to move almost all services out of the station

The bridges, which rise to the height of apartment buildings and span neighborhood streets, have become an environmental and planning nuisance over the years, partly because of the noise and air pollution associated with the station’s operations. The municipality said removing them is intended to improve quality of life for residents of nearby neighborhoods, enhance public spaces and improve conditions along the Purple Line. Plans will also advance to redesign HaHarash Street, turning it from a street that mainly serves station operations into an urban street as part of the extension of Kirya Boulevard.

The bridge demolition does not mark the closure of the Central Bus Station itself. Under the broader plan agreed with the government, the station is expected to move to the Mikveh Israel site in about five years. As part of the planned changes, bus routes with low ridership will be moved out of the station and Egged and Dan are expected to move almost all their services out.

As reported by Globes, dismantling the bridges is one of the preliminary steps in a transport and urban redevelopment of the area that is expected to take years. When work begins in January, it will mark the first significant physical change at the Central Bus Station complex and in the surrounding area.
Published by Globes, Israel business news - en.globes.co.il - on November 26, 2026.

articles.title: שני איטלקים נהרגו במתקפת כטב"מים איראנית בכוויית, טהרן טוענת: לא תקפנו
articles.summary: לפי דיווחים באיטליה, שני ההרוגים היו טכנאים שעבדו עבור ענקית התעשיות הביטחוניות הגרמנית ריינמטאל. משרד ההגנה הכווייתי מסר כי כמה כטב"מים שוגרו לעבר המדינה, וכי מהרסיסים נפצעו גם אזרח מקומי ואזרח פקיסטני
paragraphs: לפי דיווחים באיטליה, שני ההרוגים היו טכנאים שעבדו עבור ענקית התעשיות הביטחוניות הגרמנית ריינמטאל. משרד ההגנה הכווייתי מסר כי כמה כטב"מים שוגרו לעבר המדינה, וכי מהרסיסים נפצעו גם אזרח מקומי ואזרח פקיסטני

שני אזרחים איטלקים נהרגו היום (חמישי) במתקפת כטב"מים איראנית בכוויית. כך מסר לסוכנות הידיעות רויטרס גורם המעורה בפרטים, שאישר גם דיווח דומה בסוכנות הידיעות האיטלקית ANSA. שני ההרוגים היו טכנאים שעבדו עבור תאגיד התעשיות הביטחוניות הגרמני ריינמטאל. מוקדם יותר הודיע משרד ההגנה הכוויתי כי ארבעה בני אדם נפצעו במתקפה, בהם שני האזרחים האיטלקים.
(צילום: various sources / AFP)

בהודעה הרשמית של כוויית נמסר כי כוחות הביטחון במדינה זיהו כמה כטב"מים עוינים במרחב האווירי שלה, ו"נקטו נגדם את הצעדים המתאימים". עוד נמסר כי "התוקפנות האיראנית הבלתי חוקית הזו כוונה נגד אתר חיוני, וגרמה לנפילת רסיסים שפצעו ארבעה בני אדם: אזרח כווייתי, שני אזרחים איטלקים ואזרח פקיסטני". לפי ההודעה, הפצועים פונו לבית חולים לקבלת טיפול רפואי, ונזק נגרם לרכוש. בהמשך דיווחה סוכנות הידיעות האיטלקית כי שני האזרחים האיטלקים מתו מפצעיהם.

איראן הכחישה כי היא זו שתקפה בכוויית. דובר הצבא האיראני טען כי הכוחות האיראניים לא ביצעו שום פעולות צבאיות או התקפיות באזור". עוד נכתב ברשת תסנים כי "לאור השימוש של ארה"ב וישראל בטקטיקות של דגל כוזב, ההאשמות נתפסות כניסיון להחריף את חוסר הביטחון באזור".

במשרד ההגנה הכווייתי לא חשפו מהו האתר שהותקף ומה היקף הנזק שנגרם לו. עוד הדגישו במשרד כי הכוחות המזוינים במדינה נמצאים בכוננות גבוהה ונוקטים את כל הצעדים הדרושים כדי להגן על ריבונותה, ביטחונה ויציבותה של כוויית.

בעיתון האיטלקי "לה רפובליקה" דווח כי ההרוגים עסקו בתפעול מערכות להגנה מפני כטב"מים, וכי ככל הנראה היו חלק ממערך של אנשי צבא ואזרחים שנשלחו החל מחודש מרץ לסייע בהגנה על מדינות המפרץ מפני התקיפות האיראניות, וכן להגן על מקורות האנרגיה שמהם מקבלת איטליה אספקה. בעקבות המתקפה שונו גם נתיבי הטיסה של מטוסים אזרחיים באזור המפרץ. רשת "יורוניוז" דיווחה כי מטוסים שהיו בדרכם מאירופה למדינות המפרץ דרך עיראק נאלצו לשנות את מסלולם בעקבות דיווחים על סגירת המרחב האווירי של כווית.
מכלית נפט שפגעה במוקשים ימיים בכניסה לנמל בעומאן ביום שבת

המתקפה היום מגיעה לאחר שבשבוע שעבר חידשה איראן את תקיפותיה בכוויית, לראשונה מאז חודש ספטמבר. ביום רביעי שעבר הודיע צבא איראן כי תקף מתקנים אמריקניים בבסיס חיל האוויר עלי א-סאלם שבכוויית, בתגובה לתקיפה אמריקנית באי האיראני קשם שבמצר הורמוז. במקביל תקפה איראן גם בבחריין, וסעודיה גינתה בחריפות את המתקפות על שכנותיה במפרץ.

כוויית, בעלת ברית קרובה של ארה"ב שמארחת אלפי חיילים אמריקנים בשטחה, הייתה אחת ממדינות המפרץ שספגו את מרבית התקיפות האיראניות מאז פרוץ המלחמה בסוף פברואר. לפי ניתוח תצלומי לוויין שפרסמה בסוף אוקטובר סוכנות הידיעות AP, מרבית התקיפות האיראניות נגד מתקנים אמריקניים באזור בוצעו בשטח כוויית.

כוויית מצידה טענה לאורך המלחמה כי לא השתתפה בפעולות התקפיות נגד איראן. במכתבים שהעבירה למועצת הביטחון של האו"ם האשימה כוויית את טהרן בהפרת החוק הבינלאומי ובפגיעה בתשתיות אזרחיות חיוניות, ודחתה את הטענה האיראנית שלפיה התקיפות בשטחה נעשו במסגרת הזכות להגנה עצמית.

articles.title: Musk pledges two SpaceX shares for every US child in $18 billion AI charm offensive
articles.summary: About 72 million US children under 18 makes Musk pledge worth about $18 billion; Musk last month said he would give one SpaceX share to every child in America next year; AI rival Anthropic plans new fund for the 'public good': 'It is, after all, Thanksgiving!'
paragraphs: About 72 million US children under 18 makes Musk pledge worth about $18 billion; Musk last month said he would give one SpaceX share to every child in America next year; AI rival Anthropic plans new fund for the 'public good': 'It is, after all, Thanksgiving!'

Elon Musk plans to gift every child in the United States two SpaceX ⁠shares, as he attempts to build public support for his satellite and AI businesses during a period of intense public and political scrutiny of the technology sector.

The world's richest person announced the share giveaway, which is worth a total of around $18 billion, on the eve of Thanksgiving and just hours after SpaceX won US approval on Wednesday to deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space.
Elon Musk attends the "A New Golden Age" summit at the US Institute of Peace, renamed The Donald J. Trump Institute of Peace by the Trump administration, in Washington, DC
(Photo: Evan Vucci/File Photo/Reuters)

Musk is seeking to expand SpaceX's role in the AI industry, even as the rapid growth of computing infrastructure raises concern about its environmental impact and the economic and political influence of technology billionaires.
Opponents of data center development were among the biggest winners for the Democrats in this month's US midterm elections.

"The initiative clearly helps broaden public participation in the SpaceX story," Chez Anbu, head of wealth advisory at OCBC in Singapore, said on Thursday. "Giving children a direct economic stake in the company creates a powerful narrative around broader participation in the benefits of the AI and space economy," Anbu added.
The Federal Communications Commission said it approved SpaceX's satellite constellation proposal to help meet rapidly growing demand for AI computing.

Astronomers have long been concerned about such developments in space and the American Astronomical Society said it was "disheartened and dismayed" by the FCC's decision. It warned the proposed constellation would "significantly undermine decades of federal investment in astronomical facilities" and the ability of astronomers and the public to enjoy and study the night sky.
Children would receive one share from SpaceX and one from him personally, Musk said in a brief post on X.
In a separate post, Musk said the SpaceX company shares would be transferred next month. "The share directly from me will be transferred when my lockup expires in June next year," ⁠Musk added.

SpaceX said earlier on Wednesday it would contribute one newly issued share of its Class A common stock to every currently active Trump Account, adding that Musk would personally match the number of shares donated by the company.

A Trump Account is a program designed to give Americans under the age of 18 a stake in the stock market and help build wealth from an early age. The White House said in October it had opened almost 70 million accounts. SpaceX shares closed at $127.44 on Wednesday, valuing the pledge at nearly $18 billion.
SpaceX did not respond to a request for comment on whether Musk's SpaceX share donations would be ⁠linked to Trump Accounts.

"What it does is build a massive, long-term retail shareholder base," said Christopher Brankin, global markets advisor at brokerage Mitrade Group. "It builds immediate market engagement and creates a massive, financially literate client pipeline for trading platforms as that generation comes of age," he added.
"Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America. This will be the first of many," Musk said in a post on X at the time.

"Giving shares, which are stakes in the future economy, directly ⁠to the people is the way," said Musk, most of whose philanthropic efforts have been through the Musk Foundation, which reportedly holds more than $14 billion in assets.
SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell and her husband in October pledged a share of their SpaceX stock to each of more than 2 million children under the Trump initiative.
Musk and AI rival Anthropic have sharply different blueprints for sharing some of the spoils of the AI boom.

Anthropic, which went public earlier this month, said in October that it was committing 5% of its shares to a new fund for the "public good." Anthropic said its initiative, worth around $54 billion at current prices, would give it more flexibility and scale to make donations for the benefit of humanity.

"It’s likely publicity for the Trump accounts... and also a counter to the Anthropic philanthropy noise that is likely to emerge," said Mark Tinker, chief investment officer at Toscafund HK in Hong Kong. "It is, after all, Thanksgiving!" Tinker added.

articles.title: UK steps up war preparations as Russia threatens NATO with nuclear strikes
articles.summary: Britain contacts former service personnel for the first time since the Cold War as tensions with Moscow escalate; meanwhile, secret diplomatic efforts aim to avert a clash in the Baltic Sea, where Russia has threatened preemptive nuclear strikes to protect its vital oil routes
paragraphs: Britain contacts former service personnel for the first time since the Cold War as tensions with Moscow escalate; meanwhile, secret diplomatic efforts aim to avert a clash in the Baltic Sea, where Russia has threatened preemptive nuclear strikes to protect its vital oil routes

Britain is stepping up preparations for a possible war amid growing concerns about a direct military confrontation between Russia and NATO. The British newspaper The Telegraph reported Thursday that, for the first time since the Cold War, the Ministry of Defense has sent letters to approximately 100,000 military reservists as part of preparations for the possibility that they may be required to return to service during a national emergency.
(Photo: Getty Images/Sean Gallup)

The letters sent in Britain, signed by the chiefs of the Army, Royal Air Force and Royal Navy, invite recipients to volunteer for military training and exercises, including NATO's flagship Steadfast Defender exercise scheduled for next spring. Reservists were also asked to update their contact information and provide details of their current employment and skills acquired since leaving the military.

The recipients belong to Britain's Strategic Reserve, which consists of former military personnel who remain legally obligated to return to service in exceptional circumstances. This differs from members of the regular reserve forces, who voluntarily serve alongside their civilian careers.
The Ministry of Defense emphasized that the initiative does not signal an imminent mobilization. Rather, it is intended to strengthen preparedness and deterrence while reducing the risk of conflict.

British Defense Secretary Wes Streeting, who previously warned that Britain must be ready for war within 1,000 days, told Sky News on Thursday morning that the country was operating in an environment with an elevated threat level. Contacting the reservists, he said, was a sensible and necessary precaution.

According to The Telegraph, London is seeking to strengthen its ability to respond to emergencies, partly in accordance with Article 3 of the NATO treaty, which requires member states to maintain and develop their individual and collective capacity to resist armed attack.

The initiative comes as Britain's regular Army has shrunk to approximately 73,000 active-duty soldiers, its smallest size since the Napoleonic Wars. A British Army source told the newspaper that the goal was not simply to establish contact with former service members but also to understand what skills they could now contribute.
"Just because you used to be a tank driver in the Army doesn't mean your civilian skills today aren't completely different, and perhaps even more useful to defense," the source explained.
British Defense Secretary Wes Streeting said contacting the reservists was a sensible and necessary precaution
(Photo: Neal/Getty Images)

Veterans Minister Calvin Bailey sought to ease concerns about an imminent call-up. "Our strength lies not only in our weapons and equipment, but also in our people," he said, adding that although most members of the Strategic Reserve would never be recalled to service, the existence of the reserve contributes to deterrence and helps prevent war.
Britain's preparations follow a series of incidents that have alarmed NATO members.

Last week, Russia launched cruise missiles that entered eastern Poland, approximately 100 kilometers (62 miles) from a British-led military exercise. The British defense secretary and the head of the Royal Air Force were visiting the exercise that same day.

Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk raised the possibility that the incident was a deliberate provocation directed at Britain, Poland and other NATO countries. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham strongly condemned the incident and pledged to assist Poland in every possible way.

The missile launches coincided with a summit in China attended by Russian President Vladimir Putin, U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. During the meeting, Trump displayed warmth toward his Russian counterpart, even referring to him as a "friend."

Reports Wednesday also indicated that the Royal Air Force had begun moving aircraft into hangars overnight and was planning to install anti-drone protective netting at its bases to shield aircraft from possible attacks.

While Britain strengthens its military readiness, Western governments fear that the Baltic Sea could become the site of a direct confrontation between Russia and NATO. According to The Wall Street Journal, intensive diplomatic contacts have taken place in recent months, some of them secretly, in an effort to prevent tensions in the region from escalating into war.
Russian President Putin at a press conference after the trilateral summit with the leaders of the US and China
(Photo: Maxim Shemetov/Pool/Reuters)

More than 60% of Russia's seaborne oil exports pass through the Baltic Sea, making it a vital route for the country's wartime economy. But the sea is almost entirely surrounded by NATO member states, and Moscow fears Western countries could impose a naval blockade and disrupt Russian trade.

In recent months, according to Western officials, Moscow has ordered warships carrying nuclear-capable missiles to escort Russian oil tankers and prevent Western forces from boarding them. The German coast guard has documented 260 instances of Russian warships escorting vessels in the Baltic and North seas over a period of slightly more than a year.

In May, Russia passed legislation allowing military force to be used to protect commercial vessels. At the same time, according to Western intelligence officials, Moscow reinforced its forces in the Kaliningrad exclave, located between Poland and Lithuania, deploying drones, radar systems and electronic warfare equipment.

In August, Putin described European efforts to act against Russian tankers as "acts of piracy and robbery" and promised a military response. A month later, the Kremlin reportedly delivered an unusual written warning to NATO, stating that Russia was prepared to launch preemptive nuclear strikes to protect its interests in the Baltic Sea, even if Russian territory had not been attacked.
Russian warship involved in confrontation with German ships in the Baltic Sea: 'High risk of escalation'

A major source of the tensions is Russia's so-called shadow fleet, a network of tankers used by Moscow to circumvent Western sanctions on its oil exports. Since late 2024, at least 14 incidents have been documented in which tankers suspected of belonging to the fleet were seized or boarded by Western forces. Such operations in the Baltic Sea largely came to a halt earlier this year after Russian naval vessels began confronting ships attempting to intercept the tankers.

An incident in late June illustrated how volatile the situation had become. Greenpeace environmental activists approached a suspected shadow-fleet tanker in motorboats when a Russian warship moved toward them, apparently because its crew mistakenly believed the activists were coast guard personnel preparing to seize the tanker.

A German coast guard vessel rushed to protect the activists. Its commander managed to prevent an escalation by explaining to the Russians that the boats belonged to civilian protesters and that nobody intended to board the tanker.
The German commander later described the encounter to his superiors as "an incident involving a high risk of escalation."

In September, the same Russian warship fired signal flares toward a Danish military helicopter monitoring its movements. A month later, two Russian warships prevented Danish and German coast guard vessels from approaching a tanker experiencing engine trouble near the Danish island of Bornholm.
According to Western officials, statements by senior European politicians have also contributed to Moscow's fears.

In September, Polish Foreign Minister Radoslaw Sikorski proposed conducting particularly aggressive military exercises near Kaliningrad, which would force Putin to divert troops from Ukraine. Days later, Estonia's foreign minister said NATO countries could close the Gulf of Finland within hours.

By late October, according to the report, senior Pentagon officials had warned their counterparts in the Baltic region against statements that could trigger a confrontation and urged them to moderate their rhetoric toward Russia.

Western governments sought to reassure Moscow that NATO had no intention of blockading Russian shipping routes. Finland summoned the Russian ambassador in an effort to ease tensions, but Finnish President Alexander Stubb feared the message was not reaching Putin.

According to The Wall Street Journal, Western officials enlisted the help of a Russian oligarch with direct access to the Kremlin as part of their efforts to prevent escalation. He traveled to Norway for talks with senior officials before returning to Moscow to deliver the message to Putin.
Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre and Finnish President Alexander Stubb: 'We will not impose a blockade'
(Photos: Lehtikuva/Emmi Korhonen via Reuters)

Days later, Stubb and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre spoke directly with the Russian president. The official purpose of the conversations was to discuss ending the war in Ukraine. Behind the scenes, however, the two Nordic leaders also sought to alleviate Russian fears of a naval blockade.

"We have no intention of blockading the Baltic Sea in peacetime. You can count on that. We will act according to the law," Stubb told Putin during their October 27 telephone conversation, according to two people who were present.
The Kremlin did not respond to the newspaper's request for comment on the report.

Following the conversations, Putin publicly praised the two leaders but claimed that some parties wanted to turn the Baltic Sea into another Strait of Hormuz, referring to disruptions in oil supplies and surging energy prices following the war between the United States and Iran.
"We don't want that, but we will respond to any challenge," Putin said, warning that if the confrontation spiraled out of control, "there will be no winners."
The understandings reached during the diplomatic contacts were tested in recent days when Ukrainian drones attacked a Russian cargo ship near Finland.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky told Bloomberg that the vessel was a legitimate target because it was carrying weapons. He said the ship had been attacked in Russian territorial waters before drifting into Finnish territorial waters. Finnish authorities launched a rescue operation in coordination with Russia. The fire that broke out aboard the ship was extinguished, and Russian personnel were permitted to tow the vessel away.

Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Monday that the attack had intensified tensions in the Baltic Sea and that Moscow expected countries in the region to use their influence over Kyiv to prevent further strikes.

The incident highlighted the fragility of the diplomatic efforts underway. Even as Western governments seek to reassure Moscow that they do not intend to cut off Russian shipping routes, military encounters and attacks connected to the war in Ukraine continue to create opportunities for a wider confrontation between Russia and NATO.

articles.title: ב-4 מילים: בן גביר מגיב למי שצפוי להחליף אותו בתפקיד
articles.summary: דקות לאחר שהוכרז כי יאיר גולן יחליף אותו בתפקיד, השר לביטחון לאומי איתמר בן גביר הגיב להסכם של הדמוקרטים ואיזנקוט
paragraphs: השר לביטחון לאומי איתמר בן גביר הגיב היום (חמישי) לחתימת ההסכם הקואליציוני בין מפלגת "ישר!" למפלגת הדמוקרטים, ממנו עולה כי יאיר גולן יחליף את בן גביר בתפקיד.

בציוץ קצר שפרסם ברשת X בן גביר שיתף דיווח של עמית סגל על ההסכמות של הדמוקרטים ואיזנקוט, שקבע תיק הביטחון לאומי ילך לגולן, וכתב כי "המחבלים שמחים, היהודים בוכים". כאמור, במפלגת הדמוקרטים הודיעו כי במסגרת ההסכמות הקואליציוניות עם "ישר!", במפלגה יקבלו את משרד ביטחון הפנים "במתכונת מורחבת", כשבכך יאיר גולן צפוי להחליף בתפקיד את איתמר בן גביר. בנוסף, הדמוקרטים יקבלו את משרדי העבודה והרווחה, משרד התקשורת, ומשרד התרבות והספורט - אשר יכלול גם "מינהל חדש לדמוקרטיה".

עוד נקבע כי המשרד לשוויון חברתי יהיה תחת אחריות שרי הדמוקרטים, והמפלגה תקבל את ראשות ועדת החוקה ותפקידים פרלמנטריים נוספים. כמו כן, נציג של הדמוקרטים יכהן בוועדה למינוי שופטים, ונציג נוסף יכהן כשר המקשר בין הממשלה לכנסת. עוד נטען כי "הדמוקרטים ביקשו את תיק המשפטים, מתוך הבנה עמוקה לחשיבות העצמאות וההגנה על מערכת המשפט. עם זאת, המחויבות שלנו להקמת ממשלת שינוי והאחריות הלאומית מחייבות אותנו לפעול במהירות, להגיע להסכמות ולגלות גם נכונות לפשרות".

articles.title: Donations to One Nation from two Gina Rinehart associates to be probed by electoral authorities
articles.summary: Exclusive: Australian Electoral Commission to review $1m in donations to Pauline Hanson-led party from Adam Giles and Ian Plimer Get our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast Major donations from close associates of One Nation’s billionaire benefactor, Gina Rinehart, will be reviewed by the Australian Electoral Commission (AEC) amid concerns they were made on behalf of a third party. The special minister of state, Don Farrell, said on Thursday that information about two $500,000 donations made to the Pauline Hanson-led party could be subject to further regulatory action if…
paragraphs: Major donations from close associates of One Nation’s billionaire benefactor, Gina Rinehart, will be reviewed by the Australian Electoral Commission (AEC) amid concerns they were made on behalf of a third party.

The special minister of state, Don Farrell, said on Thursday that information about two $500,000 donations made to the Pauline Hanson-led party could be subject to further regulatory action if they are found not to comply with provisions in the Electoral Act.
In April, Hanson thanked two of Rinehart’s closest associates and senior executives for their “investment” in the party at the same time as she revealed a private plane gifted to her by Rinehart.

The geologist Ian Plimer, who is an executive with Hancock Energy and known for his climate denialism, and Adam Giles, the head of Hancock Agriculture and former Northern Territory chief minister, each donated $500,000 to One Nation.
At the time, Hanson thanked “two wonderful patriotic Australians” for the combined $1m in contributions.
The money – and the use of the new Cirrus SR22 G7 plane, which can retail for about $2.1m – prompted Labor to accuse One Nation of being “a wholly owned subsidiary of Gina Rinehart”.
A question on notice about the donations from Plimer and Giles asked if the government had “any concerns that these donations were made on behalf of a third party”.
In answer, Farrell said the Electoral Act required relevant disclosures to be made within 2025-26 annual financial disclosure returns to the AEC, due earlier this month.
He said information about donations and in-kind support to political parties, including One Nation, would be published on the AEC’s transparency register on 1 February.
“The AEC will examine disclosures and determine whether further regulatory action is required,” Farrell said.
Guardian Australia has reported extensively on Hanson’s links to Rinehart, including her repeated failures to properly declare free flights on the mining magnate’s private jet.
Hancock Prospecting and One Nation were contacted for comment on Thursday.
The Coalition raised concerns with the federal government about whether Plimer and Giles had made the donations on behalf of a third party, asking if the source of the money would be investigated.
Crossbencher David Pocock also sought more information about the donations, using a parliamentary question on notice to ask if the AEC could investigate their source.

Guardian Australia reported in September that James Ashby, formerly Hanson’s chief of staff and now the party’s national director, drives a new Ford Ranger that was “personally” gifted to One Nation by Giles in April.
Hanson said the vehicle would help the party’s campaign efforts and “provides us the presence we need in the lead up to the next federal election”.
Hanson celebrated the defection of Liberal Leah Blyth to One Nation on Thursday, suggesting the senator would “build on One Nation’s expanding support” in South Australia.

The defection sparked recriminations from within the Coalition, even as Blyth struggled to justify her move to a party she has previously criticised – and as she fumbled key policy positions held by Hanson.
The Nationals leader, Matt Canavan, called Blyth “a turncoat” while the deputy Liberal leader, Jane Hume, said her former colleague “wasn’t a big contributor” to the Coalition.

In an interview with the Australian Financial Review on Thursday, Hanson insisted she was not controlled by Rinehart, pointing to her party’s opposition to the Australia-European Union free trade agreement.
Rinehart would benefit from the deal, including provisions to ease tariffs on beef and critical minerals.

articles.title: Millions of people to see average monthly mortgage payments rise by £100
articles.summary: More people face higher mortgage repayments when they roll off a fixed deal than previously estimated.
paragraphs: More people face higher mortgage repayments when they roll off a fixed deal than previously estimated, new figures from the the Bank of England show.

About 6.5 million owners are forecast to see their monthly repayment jump by £100 on average when they move onto their next deal by the end of 2029, new data in its Financial Stability Report reveals.
That is more the double the £45-a-month hike that the Bank estimated in its last report in July.

In the shorter term, about one million of those homeowners, who are on mortgage rates below 3% and due to refinance by the end of next year, will see an average £200 increase in their monthly repayments.

For borrowers, the interest rate on a fixed mortgage does not change until it expires, usually after two or five years, and a new one is chosen to replace it. The vast majority of homeowners and buyers have this kind of mortgage.
Since the Iran war began, global economic uncertainty has been pushing up the cost of deals, with the average rates on two and five year fixed mortgages at their highest for about three years.
On Thursday, the average rate on a two-year deal was 5.99%, and at 6% for a five-year deal, according to the financial information service Moneyfacts.
Analysts have described the situation as "brutal" for homeowners coming to the end of their fixed deals.
